timing.start: The timer starts when the complete frozen task packet becomes visible to the operator or agent.
timing.stop: The timer stops when the final candidate output is written and no further edits are permitted.

allowedInputs: The frozen fixture named by fixturePath
A calculator or local arithmetic tool for the manual run
The committed PositionCrew provider for the agent runs
prohibitedInputs: Changing the fixture, rubric, or scoring anchors after a result is seen

blinding.agentRepresentativeSelection: The first completed agent run is the quality candidate. The second run proves repeatability and is excluded from the blind packet so duplicate outputs cannot reveal source identity.
blinding.randomization: Randomize the manual output and precommitted agent representative only after all three immutable runs finish.
blinding.mappingCustody: Keep the source mapping outside the public repository until the evaluator completes and attests the scorecard.
blinding.evaluator: An independent human who did not produce any candidate and cannot see timing, cost, or source identity while scoring quality.

decisionRule: Agent advantage is supported only when the precommitted agent representative quality score is at least the manual score, both agent output hashes match, neither agent run has a critical conformance failure, and median agent elapsed time is lower than manual elapsed time. Cost is reported and never hidden.
